description: Read exactly one retained task group page by caller UUID, optionally checking expectedStoreId. limit is 1..200 (default 50); state filters lifecycle; cursor (at most 2048 characters) is bound to group/filter/store/current served generations. The logical result is at most 131072 UTF-8 bytes and may return fewer members; resume only with nextCursor. Retained-only/current-served qualifiers are not a permanent roster or proof of submission. Job handles remain canonical while runId is null until binding. Explicit unavailable observations are unknown. Requires an existing supporting daemon; discovery and HTTP reads each allow up to 5s. Host cancellation closes only the read. Never launches, retries, resumes, cancels or answers work. Lifecycle is not output readiness; use addressed result/interactions tools for bodies.

state.description: Control-plane run state = the run LIFECYCLE (D8): queued/running while live, then exactly one of succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted. Outcome quality (checks/review/delivery) is orthogonal — see outcomeFacts.

taskGroupId.description: Caller-generated UUID saved before launching the first member. Each job still needs its own idempotency key; the group grants no execution authority.
